publisher: USDA Forest Service PNW Research Station AirFire Team (USFS); VSMOKE itself Lavdas 1996, USFS Southern Research Station
licence_as_stated: GPL-3.0 (repository LICENSE.txt); the repository ships no VSMOKE source
language: prebuilt statically linked x86-64 Linux executable (Fortran 77 origin); Python driver bluesky/dispersers/vsmoke/vsmoke.py
documented_example: yes: the held manual's Appendix III example (PDF pp. 121-122)
where_found: GitHub search api: user pnwairfire repositories; the held SFE fact sheets and VSmoke-Web page name VSMOKE
evidence: Ran in a scratch amd64 image and inside the arm64 gcc:14.2.0 image under emulation with the manual's echoed inputs (docs/evidence/hb150/vsmoke_example/VSMOKE.IPT): PM2.5 centerline equals the printed table at all 31 distances; other columns within one unit of the last printed digit (vsmoke_example/compare.json). licence: GPL-3.0 permits passing it on only with its Corresponding Source, which nobody publishes for bin/vsmoke. builds: there is no source in held material to build; installing a foreign binary is not a build (DN-021 sections 3 and 9: "VSMOKE built from the held source").
